summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the refactored Taher Ali Enterprises app with React Router (Home / Products / Product Detail pages) + ShopContext. All requested features verified successfully: separate Home page (no product grid), navigation via nav link and Explore CTA to /products, product catalog with filters/search/skeleton, product detail with breadcrumb + share + WhatsApp enquiry + slim sticky purchase bar + related + recently viewed, dark mode toggle with persistence, sticky navbar across pages, cart drawer, checkout flow with correct WhatsApp URL (https://wa.me/916305486808 with encoded customer + items), Bulk Calculator modal (10 products, tier discount), mobile responsiveness (no horizontal scroll, mobile menu works).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Bulk Calculator modal testid is 'bulk-calc-modal' and Checkout modal is 'checkout-modal'/'cart-modal' — these do not match the review request's implied 'bulk-calculator-modal'. Since the review request itself does not explicitly demand these ids, treating as non-issue but noting for consistency.
Minor: Modals do not close on Escape key. Not a functional bug (users can click the X button) but a common UX affordance.
ProductDetailPage.jsx is ~330 lines with an inline MiniCard component — acceptable size but could be split for clarity.
seed_data_creation: None — using mock.js data (10 products p1..p8, p13, p14).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 listed features/flows verified via Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Key testids confirmed: hero-section, cta-explore-products-btn, products-page, product-grid (10 cards), category-tab-{all,pickles,biscuits,ghee}, product-search-input, detail-breadcrumb, back-to-products-btn, share-product-btn, whatsapp-enquiry-btn (href starts with wa.me/916305486808), sticky-purchase-bar (py-2.5, slim), sticky-qty-plus/minus, sticky-total-price (updates ₹89->₹267 for qty 3), sticky-add-to-cart-btn, sticky-buy-now-btn, cart-item-count badge, theme-toggle-btn (persists after reload), main-navbar (sticky), mobile-menu-toggle. Checkout WhatsApp URL verified to open with correct wa.me/916305486808 and encoded customer name + order items. Recently Viewed section shows previously visited products (p1, p2 appear when on p3). Bulk Calculator modal (testid 'bulk-calc-modal') opens with 10 products, +5/-5 controls, and discount tier calculation.
